body:
/sync trusts pushed field payloads far too much. Confirmed against a fresh DB:

1. Wrong-typed values are stored verbatim and served back to every member:
   `stores: "not-a-list"` (string), `category_order: {"not":"a list"}` (dict),
   `quantity: 12345` (int) all round-trip. The Android client deserializes
   `stores` as `FieldClock<List<String>>` (kotlinx strict), so ONE buggy or
   malicious member pushing a mis-typed value breaks every other member's pull
   permanently — exactly the wedge class T-32/T-47 were meant to eliminate,
   but triggered cross-client where quarantining can't help (the poison is in
   the pull, not the push queue).
2. No length caps except list notes (5000): a 100 KB item name is accepted
   (verified) — anything up to the 4 MB body cap bloats every member's sync
   forever.
3. Structurally junk payloads produce 500s instead of 422 quarantine
   envelopes: `updated_at: 2**65` → OverflowError; `id: {"weird":1}` →
   sqlite3.ProgrammingError; `changes: "junk"` → AttributeError. A 500 has no
   row_id/field details, so the Android client can't quarantine the row and
   its whole push queue wedges (the T-32 flow only handles 422).
4. `created_at` and `id` types are never validated (a string created_at would
   be stored and served to clients expecting an int).

Fix in sync.py (_parse_row/_parse_clock/_validate_item_field/
_validate_list_field) and routes/sync.py:
- validate envelope shapes: changes must be a dict, changes.lists/items lists
  of dicts, id a string (with a sane cap, e.g. 128), created_at an int within
  SQLite int64 range, updated_at an int within range;
- stores / category_order: list of strings, item count + element length caps;
- name/category/quantity/note/price.amount/updated_by: strings with sane max
  lengths (e.g. name 500, note 5000, updated_by 128);
- every rejection = ApiError 422 with row_id+field details (the existing
  quarantine envelope), never an unhandled exception.
Add tests covering each rejected shape and that a valid push still works.

Files: server/src/shoppinglist_server/sync.py,
server/src/shoppinglist_server/routes/sync.py, server/tests/test_sync_api.py.
title: Server: /sync input validation — mis-typed fields poison all members, junk payloads 500 instead of 422
